paragraphs.source_en: A month had passed since Osaka Castle fell.

units.source_en: A month had passed since Osaka Castle fell.
units.source_zh: 大坂城陷落已过一月。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂城陷落已过一月。

paragraphs.source_en: To Hon'ami Kōetsu, the world seemed to have sunk completely into hopeless corruption and confusion, bereft of both sovereign law and elegance.

units.source_en: To Hon'ami Kōetsu, the world seemed to have sunk completely into hopeless corruption and confusion, bereft of both sovereign law and elegance.
units.source_zh: 在本阿弥光悦看来，世间已完全陷入无可救药的堕落和混乱之中，没了“王法”，也没了风雅。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在本阿弥光悦看来，世间已完全陷入无可救药的堕落和混乱之中，没了“王法”，也没了风雅。

paragraphs.source_en: Kyoto's merchants had imagined that the fall of the Toyotomi clan would bring peace to the realm and had rejoiced greatly; yet more than a month after the castle's fall, dealing with the aftermath proved even more troublesome than the war itself. Everyone's life was in turmoil, with no one knowing what lay ahead.

units.source_en: Kyoto's merchants had imagined that the fall of the Toyotomi clan would bring peace to the realm and had rejoiced greatly; yet more than a month after the castle's fall, dealing with the aftermath proved even more troublesome than the war itself. Everyone's life was in turmoil, with no one knowing what lay ahead.
units.source_zh: 京城商家以为，丰臣氏的败亡带来了世间太平，自甚是快意，但城破月余，善后之事比战事还麻烦，众人的日子一团糟，不知何之将往。

paragraphs.source_zh: 京城商家以为，丰臣氏的败亡带来了世间太平，自甚是快意，但城破月余，善后之事比战事还麻烦，众人的日子一团糟，不知何之将往。

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu believed that the Ōgosho must have seen this confusion and delayed his return because of it. Itakura Katsushige had told Kōetsu to go and bid the Ōgosho farewell, but he had yet to receive an answer.

units.source_en: Kōetsu believed that the Ōgosho must have seen this confusion and delayed his return because of it.
units.source_zh: 光悦认为，大御所定是看到了此种混乱，才迟些回去。

units.source_en: Itakura Katsushige had told Kōetsu to go and bid the Ōgosho farewell, but he had yet to receive an answer.
units.source_zh: 板仓胜重曾令光悦去与大御所道别，但他至今无回复。

paragraphs.source_zh: 光悦认为，大御所定是看到了此种混乱，才迟些回去。板仓胜重曾令光悦去与大御所道别，但他至今无回复。

paragraphs.source_en: Why were people so foolish? Now that the war was over, they ought to have considered how to make their lives, yet instead of settling down to peaceful work, they answered grievance with grievance. Was the Buddhist Pure Land, in the end, no more than an unattainable promise painted on paper?

units.source_en: Why were people so foolish?
units.source_zh: 世人为何如此愚蠢？

units.source_en: Now that the war was over, they ought to have considered how to make their lives, yet instead of settling down to peaceful work, they answered grievance with grievance.
units.source_zh: 战事结束，本应思量怎样过活，他们非但不安居乐业，反而冤冤相报。

units.source_en: Was the Buddhist Pure Land, in the end, no more than an unattainable promise painted on paper?
units.source_zh: 佛家所言极乐世界，最终不过是一张纸上画饼吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 世人为何如此愚蠢？战事结束，本应思量怎样过活，他们非但不安居乐业，反而冤冤相报。佛家所言极乐世界，最终不过是一张纸上画饼吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu wanted Sōtatsu to decorate his authentication papers with patterns of autumn grasses, spring horsetails, royal ferns, and other plants. He used this as a pretext for visiting, but in truth he could not dispel the question troubling him: what did Sōtatsu think of the present disorder?

units.source_en: Kōetsu wanted Sōtatsu to decorate his authentication papers with patterns of autumn grasses, spring horsetails, royal ferns, and other plants.
units.source_zh: 光悦欲让宗达在自己的鉴定纸上绘上秋草、春天的节节草以及紫萁之类的花草做底纹。

units.source_en: He used this as a pretext for visiting, but in truth he could not dispel the question troubling him: what did Sōtatsu think of the present disorder?
units.source_zh: 光悦以此为借口前去拜访，实是因无法排遣心中困惑：宗达对现今这混乱局面怎样看？

paragraphs.source_zh: 光悦欲让宗达在自己的鉴定纸上绘上秋草、春天的节节草以及紫萁之类的花草做底纹。光悦以此为借口前去拜访，实是因无法排遣心中困惑：宗达对现今这混乱局面怎样看？

paragraphs.source_en: No sound of weaving came from Sōtatsu's house. There was nothing strange about that. Sōtatsu had once joked that he was now a painter, and that many people even wished to become his pupils and learn painting from him.

units.source_en: No sound of weaving came from Sōtatsu's house.
units.source_zh: 宗达宅中并未传来织布之声。

units.source_en: There was nothing strange about that.
units.source_zh: 这无甚奇怪。

units.source_en: Sōtatsu had once joked that he was now a painter, and that many people even wished to become his pupils and learn painting from him.
units.source_zh: 宗达曾笑称，如今他已成画师，甚至有很多人想拜他为师，向他学习绘画。

paragraphs.source_zh: 宗达宅中并未传来织布之声。这无甚奇怪。宗达曾笑称，如今他已成画师，甚至有很多人想拜他为师，向他学习绘画。

paragraphs.source_en: As Kōetsu approached the studio, he saw Sōtatsu sitting with his back to the doorway, painting on paper spread across the floor; it appeared to be a folding screen.

units.source_en: As Kōetsu approached the studio, he saw Sōtatsu sitting with his back to the doorway, painting on paper spread across the floor; it appeared to be a folding screen.
units.source_zh: 光悦走近画室，却见宗达正背对门口，在铺于地上的纸上作画，画的似是屏风。

paragraphs.source_zh: 光悦走近画室，却见宗达正背对门口，在铺于地上的纸上作画，画的似是屏风。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh? For which noble person is this gift intended?” When Sōtatsu ignored him, Kōetsu removed his sandals, walked up behind him, and watched him paint.

units.source_en: “Oh? For which noble person is this gift intended?”
units.source_zh: “哦，这是送给哪位贵人的礼？”

units.source_en: When Sōtatsu ignored him, Kōetsu removed his sandals, walked up behind him, and watched him paint.
units.source_zh: 光悦见宗达不理，遂脱了草鞋，走到宗达身后，看他作画。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦，这是送给哪位贵人的礼？”光悦见宗达不理，遂脱了草鞋，走到宗达身后，看他作画。

paragraphs.source_en: It was a very strange painting. It showed neither the puppies nor the flowers and grasses at which Sōtatsu excelled, but pellet drums—not just one, but groups of two or three arranged in circles to form the background pattern.

units.source_en: It was a very strange painting.
units.source_zh: 真是一幅奇怪的画。

units.source_en: It showed neither the puppies nor the flowers and grasses at which Sōtatsu excelled, but pellet drums—not just one, but groups of two or three arranged in circles to form the background pattern.

units.source_zh: 这并非宗达擅长的幼犬或花草，纸上乃是拨浪鼓，不止一个，两三个拨浪鼓围成一圈，是为画的底纹。

paragraphs.source_en: Still unaware that anyone had arrived, Sōtatsu hummed aloud, lost in thought.

units.source_en: Still unaware that anyone had arrived, Sōtatsu hummed aloud, lost in thought.
units.source_zh: 宗达还未识得人来，他吟哦有声，陷入沉思。

paragraphs.source_en: What was Sōtatsu trying to paint? Just as Kōetsu was utterly at a loss, Sōtatsu took a sheet from the pile of discarded paper beside his knee and spread it over the painting paper.

units.source_en: What was Sōtatsu trying to paint?
units.source_zh: 宗达想画什么？

units.source_zh: 正在光悦百思不得其解时，宗达从膝旁的废纸堆中拿出一纸，在画纸上展了开来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, the Thunder God!” Kōetsu's eyes widened. Sōtatsu seemed intent on painting the Thunder God beating pellet drums in midair. The Thunder God had a befuddled, childlike face, without the slightest dignity or ferocity. Amiable and approachable, he was plainly Sōtatsu himself, intoxicated by the music of a festival.

units.source_en: “Ah, the Thunder God!”
units.source_zh: “啊，雷神！”

units.source_en: The Thunder God had a befuddled, childlike face, without the slightest dignity or ferocity. Amiable and approachable, he was plainly Sōtatsu himself, intoxicated by the music of a festival.

paragraphs.source_en: No, this was not Sōtatsu. He had seen that face somewhere before. Kōetsu suddenly remembered. With a soft exclamation, he reflected in silence: it was the face of Lord Ieyasu, now residing at Nijō Castle—commanding without anger, majestic without cruelty.

units.source_en: No, this was not Sōtatsu. He had seen that face somewhere before.

units.source_zh: 光悦突然想起来，他哦了一声，心下默然：这是现正居于二条城的家康公面目，不怒而威，威而不戾。

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu could not resist patting Sōtatsu on the shoulder. But Sōtatsu's reaction took Kōetsu completely by surprise. He turned around, and his expression instantly froze.
